rationale: The agent executed multiple write actions (modifying an order’s shipping address, exchanging an item in a pending order, and updating the default address) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. There is no clear authentication step beyond looking up by email, which does not meet the stated policy requirement to authenticate before acting. The exchange was performed to a specific tablet model/price without establishing that it is the cheapest option, contrary to the user’s request, and without confirmation of any additional charges/refunds or payment method use. The final response did not explicitly mention the order-level address change (only the default address update and the exchange), and the refund statement appears truncated, so the final information is incomplete. These issues collectively fail the pass bar.
